morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不按马来语词缀拆分。此处给出按源语辅音读出的参考音，ch 表示 /t͡ʃ/。chakra 与 cakra 均见于相关论述；本条未核实 chakra 的 DBP 独立词条，official 仅沿用指定的数据状态。

senses.zh_definition: 脉轮：某些印度宗教、瑜伽和冥想传统所描述的微细身体能量中心。
senses.en_definition: A spiritual energy centre in the subtle body, as described in certain Indian religious, yogic, and meditative traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Pusat tenaga dalam tubuh halus menurut kepercayaan dan amalan kerohanian tertentu, khususnya dalam tradisi yoga dan agama India.
senses.nuances: 属于特定传统的身体观与修行术语。不同传统对其数量和位置有不同解释，不宜把所有体系都概括为固定七轮，也不应将其直接解释为解剖器官。此处马来文释义为编写释义。[史密森尼亚洲艺术国家博物馆：瑜伽与脉轮图像](https://asia.si.edu/whats-on/exhibitions/yoga-the-art-of-transformation/)

senses.zh_definition: 印度宗教图像中的轮形象征或圆盘状法器；具体可指佛教法轮或毗湿奴所持的轮状武器。
senses.en_definition: A wheel or discus in Indian religious symbolism, including the Buddhist Dharma wheel and Vishnu's discus.
senses.ms_definition: Lambang berbentuk roda atau cakera dalam ikonografi agama India, termasuk roda Dharma dalam agama Buddha dan senjata cakera yang dipegang oleh Vishnu.
senses.nuances: 用于宗教、艺术史或神话语境；具体所指须由图像或上下文确定，不能一律译为“脉轮”。此处马来文释义为编写释义。[史密森尼亚洲艺术国家博物馆：chakra](https://asia.si.edu/glossary/chakra/)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penceramah menerangkan konsep chakra dalam tradisi yoga serta perbezaan tafsirannya antara aliran.
dual_scenarios.zh: 讲者介绍了瑜伽传统中的脉轮概念，以及不同流派对它的不同解释。
dual_scenarios.en: The speaker explained the concept of chakras in yoga traditions and how interpretations differ between schools.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku baru baca pasal chakra jantung ni, tapi tak berapa faham lagi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya baru membaca tentang chakra jantung ini, tetapi masih kurang memahaminya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚看了点心轮的介绍，不过还没太看懂。
dual_scenarios.en: I've just been reading about the heart chakra, but I don't really understand it yet.

messages.ms_standard: Dalam buku yang saya baca, itu hanya salah satu chakra. Mahukah kamu saya tunjukkan rajahnya?

messages.en: In the book I read, that's just one of the chakras. Want me to show you the diagram?

etymology.historical_story: Chakra comes from Sanskrit cakra, meaning wheel or cycle. That circular image appears in several religious settings: a Buddhist symbol of teaching, Vishnu's discus, and representations of spiritual centres in yogic traditions. Remembering the wheel helps connect these meanings, while the surrounding religious tradition determines which interpretation is intended. [Smithsonian glossary](https://asia.si.edu/glossary/chakra/), [yoga exhibition](https://asia.si.edu/whats-on/exhibitions/yoga-the-art-of-transformation/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作“查克拉”，联想一只转动的轮：宗教图像中是轮形象征，瑜伽语境中是脉轮。
